title: Happy Oyster: Alibaba Real-time Interactive AI World Model
summary: An advanced AI world model by Alibaba that simulates interactive, infinite virtual environments with consistent physics in real-time. It supports both a first-person exploration mode and a director mode for live control of scenes and characters.
research_notes: Capable of generating up to 3 minutes of continuous video with synchronized audio, modeling physical properties like gravity and lighting.

evolution.summary: Launched in April 2026 after topping global text-to-video benchmarks under the pseudonym 'HappyHorse-1.0'. It represents a transition from short video generation to persistent real-time environmental simulation.
